commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' The referee Sven Jablonski awards Matus Bero (Bochum) a yellow card.
90+2' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from Bochum won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
90' Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
89' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
85' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
83' Donny van de Beek comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Here's the change. Philipp Max leaves the pitch and Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.

82' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jens Grahl anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
80' Today's referee Sven Jablonski rightly decides to book Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his harsh tackle.
78' The attendance is 58000.
77' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
76' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
75' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
74' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann makes a comfortable save.
71' A substitution has been made. Takuma Asano goes off and Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) comes on.
70' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
70' Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
69' A cross into the box picks out Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
66' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
66' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Jens Grahl.
65' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
65' A substitution has been made. Omar Marmoush is replaced by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Half-chance! Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Manuel Riemann reacts well to snuff out the attack.
63' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
59' Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
58' Takuma Asano (Bochum) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.

57' A sweet pass inside the box gives William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
56' Bernardo (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
55' Takuma Asano (Bochum) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jens Grahl.
53' The foul by William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Sven Jablonski.
52' Eintracht Frankfurt fail to score from a corner as Manuel Riemann (Bochum) leaps to collect the ball.

52' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
49' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
48' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
47' Matus Bero (Bochum) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Eintracht Frankfurt couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Manuel Riemann (Bochum) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
45+4' It looks like Ivan Ordets (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Sven Jablonski won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

45+3' This was a nice set play that lacked a finish. Unmarked Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick and unleashed a long-range shot. He hit the ball very poorly, sending it into the stands.
45+2' Bochum work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+2' Takuma Asano (Bochum) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
41' The free kick is taken by Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt), but ball is cleared.
40' A player from Bochum commits a rough challenge. Sven Jablonski blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
38' Manuel Riemann leaps to intercept the corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
37' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
35' A yellow card for a tackle by Tim Oermann (Bochum). Sven Jablonski doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
30' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Eintracht Frankfurt for a penalty. Play continues.
30' Takuma Asano (Bochum) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' The linesman signals a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
27' Good movement by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
27' So close! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
26' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

26' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
25' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
21' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) will replace Hugo Larsson.
21' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' 1 - 1 Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Jens Grahl. 1:1.
14' 1 - 0 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
13' The ball falls kindly for Matus Bero (Bochum) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
11' Bochum are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' A player from Bochum commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
8' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Matus Bero (Bochum) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
5' Bochum are ruled offside.
4' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
4' The ball is behind the touchline and Bochum will take a throw-in.
3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) but poses no threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will officiate today.
